scope.tablesUnchangedReason: SkillExcel already exported; SkillLogic and LogicEffect_PC are MemoryPack tables, not ExcelDB FlatBuffers tables.

provenanceLimits: JP data; exact observed KR build and equivalence remain unverified.

structure.conditionalArrivalExplanation: 32+92=124 skill frames if spawner local time starts at spawn. Small last release75; stationary distance<=650 and Speed2000 interpreted as units/s imply <=9.75 travel frames, hence <=84.75. These clock/unit/position/target-motion assumptions are not native-consumer or exact arrival proof.
structure.distributionCompositionLimit: Parent5000 and child5000 refer to the same large path; whether inheritance/override/multiplication applies is not proven. Diagnostics retain original W5 effective5000 hypothesis; no doubled damage node.

recalculation.hpBoundsReason: Alive-target interval. StartingHP7700000 known; no normal-attack count, self-effect history, or reset rule. Do not subtract only observed EX damage or assume full HP each cast. BP envelope[10000,20000] is conservatively rounded outwards for conditional linear candidate.
assumptions: Original W5 reduced BP operation order retained, not raw-consumer certified
Effective damage distribution500/5000, no multiplication of parent/child5000
Modifier multiplier stays within configured1..2 endpoints and is monotone; insertion before weakness as in W5
All relevant neutral runtime ratios except intrinsicDamageRatio12420; no shield/immunity/caps
H0/H1 remain alternative stat interpretations; neither is adopted
JPEX5 raw coefficient used; JP/KR/Steam behavior equivalence not established
